# Security Policy

**Do not disclose security-related issues publicly.**

## Supported Versions

The `1.x` line of `watchtowerapm/agent` (package **1.0.0** and follow-up 1.x releases) receives security fixes.

## Reporting a Vulnerability

Report vulnerabilities privately via [GitHub Security Advisories](https://github.com/watchtowerapm/agent/security/advisories/new) for this repository.
